Hello, everyone. Thanks for your constant love and support for Muse Dash.
Now we have an important notice regarding in-game purchases for you.
 
After Sept 27, 2024(UTC+8), the following adjustments will be made:
1. The DLCs now on sale will be pulled off shelves. The players who haven't purchased them will be unable to obtain them. And those who have made purchases can permanently unlock and play them.

The DLCs that will be pulled from shelves soon are the limited-time offers [Miku in Museland] and [Rin·Len's Mirrorland].

New song packs, new characters, and new collabs are all in preparation. There will still be major updates in the future, and if you purchase Muse Plus, you will receive these updates for free without any additional cost. Please stay tuned!
 
To give back to players who always support us, we will carry on the good work and provide a better gaming experience for you~

notes.content:
It’s time of the final Ultimate challenge! Don’t miss out on the last chance for the prizes!

The Ultimate challenge: Jul 04th to Jul 09th 20:00 PST 

What!
1.You thought the song for the third phase is gotta be Mujinku-Vacuum Track right? Very smart! But NO, the song of choice for the Ultimate Challenge is “Toke no Heya to Seishin Sekai” on MASTER difficulty.

First column: 10000
            10000
            10000

There is no player number limitation in each score column. Each column ends with the next different score number appears.
